notes.title: Update 1 Is Live!
notes.content:
Hello Lili Fans.

It's been a week since we first launched Lili: Child of Geos.  During that time we have been working on our first Update.

And tonight we have just pushed it live.  We give you Update 1! 

This update features:

-Pets:  Can you collect them all?
-Hats:  New hats hidden throughout Geos.
-Full Controller support:  Play the Flower Game along with everything else.
-Multiple Save Slots:  :-)

And of course we have addressed the vast majority of issues mentioned in the forums!


We look forward to what you think of the improvements.
